correctness.rationale: For distinct α_x,α_y∈(0,2), 0<u<1, independent normalized fractional Gaussian baths, derive cross-spectrum Φ_xy=u(Sx+Sy+iω(Sx−Sy))/D_u; antisymmetric lag covariance A(t) is the sine transform of ω(Sx−Sy)/D_u. Its derivative at zero reduces via the explicit beta integral to −[TxΓ(1+αx)F(u,αx)−TyΓ(1+αy)F(u,αy)]/2, fixing one positive bath-strength ratio. After subtracting the vanishing linear term, dominated convergence shows A(t)~±2uT_min t^(1+α_min)/(1+α_min), nonzero: hence Gaussian path time reversal fails. Independently checked three beta integrals by high-precision quadrature; noninteger limit rests on the spectral dominated-convergence argument.
